newsitem.title: USA: Comcast unit $1 bln deal may come Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Comcast unit $1 bln deal may come Thursday.

text.p: Comcast Corp unit, Comcast Cable Communications Inc, is expected to issue its $1.0 billion multi-tranche private placement debt offering as early as Thursday, syndicate sources said.
The deal is expected to include four tranches with unofficial price talk seen as follows, sources said.
- $150 million in seven-year notes with price talk seen at 125-137.5 basis points over Treasuries.
- $400 million in 10-year debt with price talk seen at 150-162.5 basis points over Treasuries.
- $200 million in 20-year debt with price talk seen at 175-187.5 basis points over Treasuries.
- $250 million in 30-year debt, putable after 12 years, with price talk seen at 150-162.5 basis points over Treasuries.
The deal is rated Ba1 by Moody's Investors Service Inc and BBB-minus by Standard & Poor's.
Net proceeds will be used to substantially reduce bank debt of the cable unit's operating subsidiaries.
